companyFieldUpdates.name: Braya Renewable Fuels
companyFieldUpdates.description: Braya Renewable Fuels is the manager-level renewable-fuels platform operating the Come By Chance refinery in Newfoundland and Labrador through Braya Renewable Fuels (Newfoundland) LP. Cresta Fund Management acquired control in November 2021, while Silverpeak-managed North Atlantic Refining Corp. retained a minority interest. ECP announced a US$300 million preferred-equity investment in April 2023. Exact sponsor percentages, voting rights and holding vehicles are not publicly disclosed, and ECP Fund V is not directly supported for this investment. Commercial renewable-diesel operations began in February 2024; after a temporary 2025 shutdown, operations resumed, and the platform announced its first 100,000-barrel Canadian renewable-diesel sale in June 2026. Braya serves fuel markets in Canada, the United States, Mexico and Europe, while sustainable aviation fuel and green hydrogen or ammonia remain planned rather than confirmed commercial products. No later sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
